name: Tessera Industries Optical Tap Micro-Splice OT-1
product_name: Tessera Industries Optical Tap Micro-Splice OT-1
description: A miniature fiber-optic tap device that splices into a fiber-optic cable without interrupting service, siphoning a fraction of the light signal for interception. The OT-1 uses a precision micro-bend technique that causes a small percentage of light to escape the fiber at the tap point, where it is captured by a detector and decoded. The signal loss is so small (0.1 dB) that it falls within normal cable attenuation tolerances and is undetectable by standard network monitoring. The device is installed in 30 seconds by a trained operator and can be placed anywhere along an accessible fiber run.

specifications.data capture: Full signal copy of fiber traffic
specifications.size: 3 cm x 1 cm attached to fiber

story_hooks: A network security audit discovered six OT-1 taps on the backbone fiber connecting a government facility to external networks — the taps had been operational for over a year, capturing every byte of the facility's communications.

An OT-1 was found on a fiber cable that carries quantum-encrypted traffic — while the encryption makes the data unreadable, the tap's metadata capture reveals communication patterns that are intelligence gold.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, elongated micro-device resembling a precision jeweler's tool or miniature clamp. The OT-1 wraps around fiber-optic cable with a hinged butterfly design, featuring a narrow central coupling chamber with integrated optics visible through a thin sapphire window.
physical_description.dimensions: 3 cm length × 1 cm width when clamped; negligible depth. Fits in a palm or shirt pocket.
physical_description.weight_description: Negligible; easily handheld. Weighs approximately 12–15 grams. Requires no carrying strap.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade titanium alloy housing with precision-machined aluminum internals; sapphire optical window.
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray with micro-brushed texture to reduce reflection. Beveled edges and polished contact points where it grips fiber.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal gray primary; accent status LED (cyan/green when armed, amber during transmission). Tessera logo in silver etched on the dorsal surface.
physical_description.interface_elements: Single recessed activation button (beneath a protective lip); micro-USB port for data offload; tiny optical status window glowing softly. Minimal tactile feedback. Gripping surfaces ribbed for precision handling in field conditions.
distinctive_features: Precision hinge mechanism with zero-clearance lock for cable coupling
Transparent sapphire viewing window revealing internal micro-optics and micro-bend chamber
Integrated LED indicator pulsing cyan when actively capturing data
Cable attachment points designed to blend seamlessly with standard network infrastructure clamps
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: TESSERA INDUSTRIES logo (sans-serif, industrial font) engraved on top panel. Model number OT-1 and serial number laser-etched on ventral surface. Regulatory stamps (GLMZ-certified, FCC-style markings) on side.
physical_description.condition_typical: In use: clamped flush to fiber-optic bundle, nearly invisible among cable runs. Slight cyan glow visible in low-light environments. Often surrounded by cable ties, conduit, and network junction boxes in server rooms or utility tunnels.
